description.p: Cosmic Tiling Manager is a native GUI utility built with libcosmic specifically designed for the COSMIC Desktop Environment (Pop!_OS). It provides an elegant way to manage window auto-tiling exceptions, allowing you to easily configure specific applications to bypass Wayland's auto-tiling mechanism and open in floating mode automatically.

ul.li: Real-time window capture via native Wayland protocols
One-click toggles to instantly enable or disable floating rules
Backup and restore capabilities for your rules across machines

screenshot.caption: Main interface displaying open windows and active exceptions
